Built from the injected InvoiceConfiguration.basePath, not environment.apiBaseUrl (SDK-06 fixed). PRD-sdk-migration-completion.md §Approved Exceptions.

permanent exception: buildTusUploadEndpoint()/isTrustedUploadUrl() no longer read environment.apiBaseUrl or window.location.origin directly (SDK-06/SDK-11 fixed) but still concatenate a hardcoded /v1 suffix onto the injected BulkLoaderConfiguration.basePath. The SDK's createTusUpload op exists, but tus-js-client owns the resumable-upload protocol end to end (its own creation POST, Location parsing, chunked PATCHes) and needs a bare endpoint URL, not an Observable-returning SDK call.
